boundary: local synthetic exact sealed runtime; not hosted, provider, production or customer proof
risk: A writer able to change mutable tenant JSON could rewrite a leave decision and its mutable domain audit together. The surviving append-only command audit recorded only version and request ID, so restart returned the substituted decision as authoritative.

failFirst.test: restart refuses jointly rewritten leave state and domain audit without immutable decision linkage

repair.digest: SHA-256 over a fixed-order canonical object containing the seal version and immutable fields
repair.readInvariant: Every version-1 append-only leave-decision seal must have one matching request whose exact fields and recomputed digest agree; otherwise reads fail closed with HTTP 503.
repair.buildAdmission: The real server/SQLite restart-and-tamper regression is executed in the discarded proof stage before runtime admission.

limitations: Legacy decisions without a version-1 immutable seal remain explicitly unverified and require a reviewed migration or reconciliation before release.
This does not protect against an operator with authority to drop SQLite append-only triggers or replace the entire database and its external evidence together.
